title: 空闲空间管理：位示图 vs 成组链接法的空间与代价
expected_output:
=== bitmap (位示图) ===
    disk blocks         = 1048576
    bits needed         = 1048576
    bitmap size         = 1048576/8 = 131072 B = 128 KB
    per-block overhead  = 1.0000 bit/block
    --- address arithmetic (block numbering starts at 1) ---
    block     1 -> word=   0 bit= 0   (back: 1 == 1 -> True)
    block    32 -> word=   0 bit=31   (back: 32 == 32 -> True)
    block    33 -> word=   1 bit= 0   (back: 33 == 33 -> True)
    block   100 -> word=   3 bit= 3   (back: 100 == 100 -> True)
    block  1024 -> word=  31 bit=31   (back: 1024 == 1024 -> True)
    block 1  -> word=0 bit=0  (zero-based numbering would give word=0 bit=1)
=== grouped link (成组链接法, UNIX) ===
    group size          = 51 (last slot holds next-group info)
    groups              = 1 + 1048576 / 50 = 20972
    metadata lives INSIDE the free blocks themselves -> 0 extra resident memory
    but each allocation may need a DISK READ to fetch the next group
=== trade-off summary ===
    bitmap      : 128 KB resident, O(1) lookup, batch scan via bit ops
    grouped link: ~0 resident memory, O(1) amortized, but extra disk IO per group refill
    bitmap wins when memory is plentiful and allocation is hot
    grouped link wins when metadata must not occupy RAM
code:
"""位示图 vs 成组链接法：空间占用与分配代价的量化对比（确定性）。"""

TOTAL_BLOCKS = 1 << 20          # 1M 盘块（约 4GB / 4KB）
WORD_BITS = 32

print("=== bitmap (位示图) ===")
bits = TOTAL_BLOCKS
bytes_needed = bits // 8
print(f"    disk blocks         = {TOTAL_BLOCKS}")
print(f"    bits needed         = {bits}")
print(f"    bitmap size         = {bits}/8 = {bytes_needed} B = {bytes_needed/1024:.0f} KB")
print(f"    per-block overhead  = {bytes_needed / TOTAL_BLOCKS * 8:.4f} bit/block")

def bitmap_addr(block_no, base=1):
    """盘块号 -> (字号, 位号)。base=1 表示盘块号从 1 开始。"""
    idx = block_no - base
    return idx // WORD_BITS, idx % WORD_BITS

def block_of(word, bit, base=1):
    return word * WORD_BITS + bit + base

print("    --- address arithmetic (block numbering starts at 1) ---")
for b in (1, 32, 33, 100, 1024):
    w, o = bitmap_addr(b)
    back = block_of(w, o)
    print(f"    block {b:5d} -> word={w:4d} bit={o:2d}   (back: {back} == {b} -> {back == b})")
w, o = bitmap_addr(1)
print(f"    block 1  -> word={w} bit={o}  (zero-based numbering would give word=0 bit=1)")

print("=== grouped link (成组链接法, UNIX) ===")
GROUP = 50                       # 每组 50 个块号，最末一项存下一组信息
print(f"    group size          = {GROUP + 1} (last slot holds next-group info)")
print(f"    groups              = 1 + {TOTAL_BLOCKS} / {GROUP} = {1 + TOTAL_BLOCKS // GROUP}")
print("    metadata lives INSIDE the free blocks themselves -> 0 extra resident memory")
print("    but each allocation may need a DISK READ to fetch the next group")

print("=== trade-off summary ===")
print(f"    bitmap      : {bytes_needed/1024:.0f} KB resident, O(1) lookup, batch scan via bit ops")
print("    grouped link: ~0 resident memory, O(1) amortized, but extra disk IO per group refill")
print("    bitmap wins when memory is plentiful and allocation is hot")
print("    grouped link wins when metadata must not occupy RAM")
